description: Wait read-only for bounded literal any/all text. source=log scans after sinceToken or a new tail baseline; source=screen requires start=current or next and never joins screen revisions. Resume scan_budget_exhausted/timeout with resumeToken and identical matching conditions. Honor gap/invalidated; old PASS must not satisfy a new round. A match is text evidence, not test success. Cancelling this wait sends no bytes.
name: novaterm_wait_text

description: Start once through the selected visible terminal with separate full-input authorization, latest inputToken and operationId. Command requires ready input; raw actions support SSH/UART prompts. Save taskId, query thereafter, and retry only identical arguments. RPC disconnect does not stop or repeat an accepted task. UART silence proves neither success nor an exit code; completion and stop capabilities depend on actual evidence.
name: novaterm_start_task

description: Query a retained task by taskId or recover admission by its original operationId. Never executes or renews control. Output uses the existing log cache; pass sinceToken to continue, and honor gaps or invalidation. State, exitCode, terminationConfirmed and evidenceKind are separate facts; unknown must not be rerun.
name: novaterm_query_task

description: Explicitly request Ctrl+C for the original task only while its target, execution and original control generations still match. Retry the same stop operationId. Human takeover or a newer command rejects stale stop without writing. stop_requested does not confirm remote termination; cancelling a read or releasing control is different.
name: novaterm_stop_task
